initial_violations.text: **What to know about GLP-1 agonists and their role in metabolic support**
If you’ve been following the conversation around GLP-1 agonists like semaglutide or tirzepatide, you’ve likely encountered a lot of hype and oversimplifications.
GLP-1 agonists are synthetic compounds designed to act similarly to a hormone your body naturally produces after eating.
We’re building a practice where GLP-1 agonists will be one option among many tools aimed at supporting metabolic health.
